cases.title: E · Paired model comparison
cases.question: Are fitted-model differences distinguishable on the inspected V1 test?
cases.method: 1,000 paired stratified customer bootstrap replicates; Model A minus Model B.
cases.result: Boosting−L2 log loss difference -0.00886; percentile 95% interval [-0.01215, -0.00562].
cases.interpretation: Negative log-loss differences favor boosting on this historical sample; intervals do not establish practical banking superiority.
cases.limitation: Retrospective, conditional on fitted models and observed class counts; no selection uncertainty.

cases.title: F · Calibration uncertainty
cases.question: How uncertain is calibration around the V1 point estimate?
cases.method: Ordinary customer bootstrap retaining event-count variability.
cases.interpretation: An overall estimate near one does not guarantee local or subgroup calibration.
cases.limitation: Fixed fitted predictions, unknown customer dependence, historical population only.

cases.title: G · Dependence and portfolio tails
cases.question: How does assumed dependence alter a hypothetical loss tail?
cases.method: 5,000 Gaussian latent-factor simulations; identical PD/LGD/EAD, rho 0 versus assumed rho 0.15.
cases.result: Independent ES95 11,016,000 NTD; common-factor ES95 20,115,180 NTD; common theoretical expected loss 9,933,705 NTD.
cases.interpretation: Common shocks change loss variability and tail risk while preserving marginal expected losses.
cases.limitation: Dependence, LGD and EAD are assumed; tail risk is neither observed bank loss nor regulatory capital.

cases.title: H · Illustrative monitoring
cases.question: How can assumed monitoring tolerances direct analytical follow-up?
cases.method: Compare frozen diagnostic values with labeled educational criteria.
cases.result: Default criteria suggest review for 0 diagnostics; this is a demonstration rather than model approval.
cases.interpretation: A diagnostic status supports investigation; changing assumed tolerances changes the status.
cases.limitation: No external bank validation, regulatory certification or model reselection.
